about_the_game:
Koltera 2 is a cozy incremental RPG where you gather resources, summon over 120 unique creatures, automate your skills, and dive into a story learning about the world of Koltera, even while you're offline. Level up 6 gathering skills and 3 workstations, each with a max level of 99. Refine items, go on expeditions, and level up your creatures. Prestige your creatures by Awakening them, earning valuable rewards and bonuses. There is a ton to level in Koltera!

Gather tons of different resources through different methods, all starting with the six core gathering skills that you focus on. Each have 99 levels to earn, unlocking new activities along the way. These resources will be critical in summoning new creatures and completing the story/quests!

Craft and refine your resources into even better resources, with three workstations, each with their own progression up to 99 levels. These resources will continue to be impactful for summoning rarer creatures and completing story/quests.

There are over 120 creatures, each with their unique summoning costs! Each creature will have stats for expeditions (a critical mid to end-game progression system and stats for job proficiencies. The job proficiencies is how effective they will be in helping you with your various gathering needs. Each creature will also feature a type and trait, which will help with expedition synergies. Awaken creatures to prestige them and raise that creatures max level to 120.

As you summon creatures, you will be able to start assigning them to each of your gathering skills so they can assist you in gathering different resources! When they earn experience, so do you. As you progress, you will find stronger and stronger creatures, eventually matching your ability to find resources. 

Complete story tasks and learn about the lore and world of Koltera. Starting out with nothing, you will grow your operation and build yourself up in order to restore the world that once was filled with creatures. Each creature you summon brings back a whole species back into the world. Humans had wiped out the creatures that roamed the world and it's your job to bring them back.

When you are away from the game, earn offline progress towards your gathering skills, workstations, and expeditions. You are free to close the game when you desire to! You will earn up to 24 hours of offline progress when you come back. For those who don't want offline progress, you will have the option to disable it as well.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2.33GHz or faster x86-compatible processor, or Intel Atom™ 1.6GHz or faster processor for netbook class devices
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Gather resources, craft items, and grow a team of creatures in this relaxed incremental idler RPG. Automate your skills, send creatures on expeditions, and keep progressing even while offline.
